polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction
framework: Database transaction log plus type-state contract: every joined material row must carry an executable audit record whose states are BLOCK, WARN, or PASS before any downstream material validation is even allowed to start.
math_object: A finite-state row audit automaton A(row) over required evidence fields. Schema presence is only a type declaration; PASS requires row-level witness objects for same-sample crosswalk, graph convention lock, external-label independence, and forbidden-control audit.

findings.finding: Round 2's tests are converted into a minimal executable row-level audit record linked to row_id, but no current candidate row has the witnesses needed for material_validation_allowed=true.
basis: C2T_joined_table_schema.csv declares required joined-table columns but lacks several execution-only audit witnesses.
C2_material_graph_rows_blocked.csv keeps all five candidate sources material_validation_allowed=false.

findings.finding: The same-sample crosswalk cannot be inferred from material or composition names. It must be executed as row-level checks over sample_id_creation_record, structure_id, snapshot_id_or_window, label_provenance_id, controls, and graph-feature source.

Graph convention lock requires a pre-label protocol witness. The current schema has G1_* metric columns, but a metric value is not auditable unless graph_convention_provenance_id, graph_cutoff_rule, seed policy, budget normalization, and same-graph identity are attached.

External-label independence must be mechanically checked per row. A label field or label_provenance_id alone is insufficient because graph-generated, synthetic, same-fit, or target-inverted labels must be blocked.
forbidden_control_audit exists in the joined-table schema as a required audit field, but Round 3 must define the structured contents of that audit. A string value of pass is not enough.

strangest_prediction.prediction: The first real failure of C2T will not be a weak graph metric; it will be a row-audit state transition failure where a visually plausible material join remains BLOCK because its sample key was created after label inspection or because carrier density is algebraically tied to the target label.
strangest_prediction.testable_consequence: When the audit artifact is run, rows with complete-looking schema columns will still collapse to BLOCK unless their witness objects prove pre-label sample-key lock, graph protocol lock, and forbidden-control independence.

a_objection: A will likely object that this adds non-physical bookkeeping rather than new materials insight. The reply is that C2T's current bottleneck is not physics interpretation but provenance type safety: without executable row-state witnesses, any graph-vs-overlap residual claim is indistinguishable from cross-sample or target-derived leakage.

failed_jumps.failure: It assumes rows already denote the same physical sample. In C2T, row identity is the unresolved object, so residual modeling is premature.
A normalized table can declare fields but cannot prove that a row-level label, structure, controls, and graph features are independent and same-sample.
failed_jumps.result: Replaced by a row audit automaton with witness records.

steps: Define C2T_row_audit_record.json schema linked by row_id without changing any material-validation status.
Require every candidate row to emit BLOCK, WARN, or PASS for same_sample_crosswalk, graph_convention_lock, external_label_independence, and forbidden_control_row_audit.
Keep material_validation_allowed=false unless all four execution blocks return PASS and all required joined-table fields have auditable provenance witnesses.
Run the audit first on the five blocked candidate-source rows only as a mechanical blocker inventory, not as material validation.
next_plan.stop_rule: If a row lacks row-level evidence, return BLOCK or WARN with missing fields; do not fill or infer the evidence from schema presence.

claims.statement: A minimal executable row-level audit artifact for C2T must be a separate witness record linked to row_id, because the current joined-table schema cannot by itself execute same-sample, graph-lock, label-independence, or forbidden-control checks.
equations: material_validation_allowed(row) = PASS_required_fields AND PASS_same_sample_crosswalk AND PASS_graph_convention_lock AND PASS_external_label_independence AND PASS_forbidden_control_row_audit
assumptions: No material validation is performed in this round.
A missing witness cannot be inferred from a field name or a non-empty schema entry.

claims.statement: All current C2T candidate-source rows remain BLOCK or diagnostic-only because the blocked-row artifact lacks raw same-sample structure graph evidence, complete crosswalks, and structured forbidden-control witness records.
assumptions: The reviewed blocked-row artifact contains the candidate rows allowed in this B Round 3 input scope.
No A output or unlisted source inventory is used.

claims.statement: The decisive audit statuses are BLOCK, WARN, and PASS: BLOCK for missing or contradictory required witnesses, WARN for present but incomplete/non-machine-reviewable evidence, and PASS only for explicit row-level witness satisfaction.
equations: BLOCK > WARN > PASS as a conservative gate order for material_validation_allowed
assumptions: Manual free-text assertions are not executable unless backed by required subfields.

row_decision.derived_rule: BLOCK if any required execution block is BLOCK; WARN if no block is BLOCK but at least one is WARN; PASS only if all required execution blocks PASS.
row_decision.material_validation_gate: material_validation_allowed may be true only when row_decision is PASS and all joined-table field-level material blockers are false.

status_logic.BLOCK: Required field or witness is missing, contradictory, target-derived, post-label, or only silently absent.
status_logic.WARN: Field exists or is declared, but evidence is partial, free-text-only, non-machine-reviewable, or cannot yet support a validation claim.
status_logic.PASS: Field exists with row-level provenance witness and passes the relevant execution block.
status_logic.schema_presence_rule: A field listed in C2T_joined_table_schema.csv is not a validation result. Schema presence can at most move a field from BLOCK to WARN when provenance remains incomplete.

missing_for_pass: num_atoms or snapshot/window metadata for graph row

required_fields_status.reason: The schema and blocker tables are adequate to define an executable audit, but current rows do not contain the required row-level witnesses.
